title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'Great companies don't die, they become soulless zombies'
summary: 51-second TikTok from Eric's BookThinkers run — a sharp line on what financial gravity does to companies that won't die but won't stay great either. Posted 5/12, 247 plays inside the first day.
blockquote: *Great companies don't die, they become soulless zombies*
